newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Victory City places HK$38 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Victory City places HK$38 mln new shares.

text.p: Fabric knitting concern Victory City International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it has agreed to place 48 million new shares, or 16.67 percent of the enlarged share capital, to third party investors at HK$0.80 each.
Victory City said net proceeds of HK$38 million would be used to buy a new office and warehouse in the United States, and for working capital.
The company shares were up HK$0.07 at HK$0.92 in mid-morning trade on Wednesday.
The stake of substantial shareholder Pearl Garden Pacific Ltd, owned by Victory City chairman Li Ming Hung, will be diluted to 26 percent from 31.3 percent.
The stake of another substantial shareholder, Madian Star Ltd, owned by managing director Chen Tien Tui, will also be diluted to 26 percent from 31.3 percent.
